customers_say: Customers find the digital lock easy to use and appreciate its safety features, with one noting it works well on wooden doors. Moreover, the installation and service receive positive feedback, with one customer highlighting the clear explanation of features. Additionally, the product is sturdy and offers good value for money, though opinions on this aspect are mixed.
